name: hyprmoncfg: Multi-Monitor Manager for Omarchy
author: Gustavo Belo (fork of Carmine Paolino's hyprmoncfg panel)
description: Plug your monitors in and the right layout comes back. Save a profile per setup and hyprmoncfg applies it automatically on hotplug, on lid open and close, and after suspend. Visual layout editor with snapping, per-output scale and sharpness checking, HDR, wide gamut and ICC colour management, mirroring, rotation, and a workspace planner. Profiles match monitors by make, model and serial rather than the port they are plugged into, so moving a cable does not break your layout.

barWidget.description: Multi-monitor layouts that switch themselves on hotplug and lid events, plus console mode for the TV.
